        >>> chunk_text("Short text.", 50)

        ['Wor', 'dAW', 'ord', 'B'] # Note: This behavior might be aggressive; see logic explanation below.

        raise ValueError("max_chars must be at least 1.")

*   Speed of Train 2 ($v_2$) = $90$ km/h
*   Time traveled by Train 1: $d_1 = v_1 \times t = 60t$
*   Time traveled by Train 2: $d_2 = v_2 \times (t - 1) = 90(t - 1)$

**Step 2: Equate the distances.**

$$60t = 90(t - 1)$$

$$ \text{Remaining Items} = \text{Total Items} - \text{Items Removed} $$
